text: {"tasks": [{"kind": "sql", "ask": "Using sf_fleet.agvs, list agv_id, model, status, faults_90d, battery_health_pct, last_service_date for all AGVs ordered by faults_90d DESC, agv_id ASC to identify the least reliable AGV by recorded faults."}, {"kind": "sql", "ask": "Using sf_fleet.agv_tasks, group by agv_id and shift_code, count total tasks, aborted tasks, late tasks, and average delay_s, ordered by (aborted + late) DESC to find which AGV fails most and in which shift."}, {"kind": "sql", "ask": "Using sf_ops.incidents, filter rows where kind='agv_fault' or agv_id is not null, group by agv_id, shift_code, cast(ts as date), count incidents, sum downtime_min, cars_lost, cost_usd ordered by incident count DESC to find the least reliable AGV and when incidents occurred."}, {"kind": "sql", "ask": "Using sf_fleet.agv_telemetry, filter fault_code is not null, group by agv_id, cast(ts as date), fault_code, count fault events ordered by count DESC to pinpoint when each AGV recorded telemetry faults."}]}

tasks.ask: Using sf_fleet.agvs, list agv_id, model, status, faults_90d, battery_health_pct, last_service_date for all AGVs ordered by faults_90d DESC, agv_id ASC to identify the least reliable AGV by recorded faults.

Using sf_fleet.agv_tasks, group by agv_id and shift_code, count total tasks, aborted tasks, late tasks, and average delay_s, ordered by (aborted + late) DESC to find which AGV fails most and in which shift.

Using sf_ops.incidents, filter rows where kind='agv_fault' or agv_id is not null, group by agv_id, shift_code, cast(ts as date), count incidents, sum downtime_min, cars_lost, cost_usd ordered by incident count DESC to find the least reliable AGV and when incidents occurred.

Using sf_fleet.agv_telemetry, filter fault_code is not null, group by agv_id, cast(ts as date), fault_code, count fault events ordered by count DESC to pinpoint when each AGV recorded telemetry faults.
